name: Theme Modal
description: Theme selection modal with two radio sections: THEMES (default / monokai) and LIGHT / DARK (dark / light). Opens from Tools > Theme menu item. Reflects current theme.base and theme.mode on open. Apply button calls theme.setTheme(base, mode) and closes. Cancel / overlay click / Escape dismiss without changes.

dependencies.usage: read theme.base and theme.mode, call theme.setTheme(base, mode) on apply

methods.name: open
methods.description: Re-render modal HTML to reflect current theme state, show overlay, register Escape key listener, store onClose callback

interactions.name: open
interactions.action: Render modal HTML with current base and mode radio checked, show overlay (display:flex), register Escape key listener

interactions.name: apply
interactions.action: Read checked values from theme-base and theme-mode radios, call theme.setTheme(base, mode), close modal, fire onClose

interactions.name: cancel
interactions.action: Close modal without applying, fire onClose

interactions.name: overlay_dismiss
interactions.action: Same as cancel — close without applying, remove Escape listener

interactions.name: escape_dismiss
interactions.trigger: Escape key while modal is visible
interactions.action: Same as cancel — close without applying, remove Escape listener

interactions.name: state_refresh
interactions.action: Re-render DOM to match current theme.base and theme.mode state

states.visible: Overlay display:flex, radios reflect current theme.base and theme.mode, Escape key registered
